resources.string: Auto-detect suits most meetings. Choose a language only when detection gets it wrong, for example when a meeting opens in a different language from the rest: a wrong choice turns the whole transcript into nonsense. Used by multilingual Whisper models and Nemotron 3.5. Parakeet v3 takes no language hint and always detects the language itself, and English-only models always transcribe English. One import or one meeting can use a different language.

AI summaries, answers, enhanced notes and titles are written in this language. Same as meeting uses the language the meeting was transcribed in, once that is known; a transcript translated to English is summarised in English. Small on-device models sometimes slip back into English.
%1$s transcribes the saved audio again. The new transcript is shown beside the current one, and nothing is replaced until you choose to use it.\n\nOn this phone that is %2$s for this meeting.
%1$s transcribes the saved audio. This meeting has no transcript yet, so the result becomes its transcript.\n\nOn this phone that is %2$s for this meeting.
Choosing the language needs a multilingual Whisper model or Nemotron 3.5: Parakeet and English-only models cannot be told which language to expect. Download one in Settings, Transcription.
